system.description: Thaumaturgy is your worst subject. Every Static Test to cast a path or ritual gains a one-Trait penalty, and casting time for any effect increases by five minutes as you fumble words, misdraw circles, or otherwise botch the fine details. You are one Social Trait down when resolving challenges against Tremere who outrank you, and you're routinely passed over for promotion or responsibility because you "just don't get it." You can still learn and begin play with Thaumaturgy, but never with more than one dot.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
